title: Global passerine song repository tree inventory
scope: Metadata-only recursive tree inspection. No repository payload, audio, source code, table content or dependency was fetched or executed.

inventory.readme_license_statement: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; component scope has not been established for third-party recordings and all repository contents.

limits: File paths, provider-reported sizes and Git blob identifiers are repository metadata. No payload checksum was recomputed.
Audio-segment file count is not a verified count of unique source recordings.
No filename-to-Xeno-canto source mapping or item-level recording license was inspected.
The GBIF CC BY-NC 4.0 metadata declaration is not a blanket license for underlying Xeno-canto audio.
The README describes acoustic motifs and ecological pattern analysis; this inventory adds no receiver-behavior or call-meaning labels.
The filename screen covers all 1,280 paths but validates only three candidate record pages and one filename/taxon match; it is not a complete join or item-level license census.
next_gate: The full filename-token inventory is metadata-only and identifies 495 candidate Xeno-canto IDs; three spot checks establish variable item-level terms, not complete rights. The official API requires a key and warns of strict rate limits. Do not scrape around those controls or retain location fields. Continue only through provider-permitted authenticated metadata access with an approved provenance/privacy scope; otherwise pivot to a cleaner task-matched dataset.

filename_id_screen.scope: Filename tokens and three public recording-page metadata checks only; no repository payloads, media, or coordinate values inspected or retained.
filename_id_screen.interpretation: The numeric filename tokens are plausible Xeno-canto IDs; three spot checks support that interpretation but do not validate all 495 candidates or establish that the sampled records belong to the study's analyzed corpus.

official_api_access_screen.decision: Do not scrape individual pages around the official API access requirements. Use only permitted authenticated API access or pivot to a cleaner source.
